name: crocodile

special_abilities.name: hold breath
special_abilities.desc: The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can't bite another target

lore:
The crocodile is a living relic of a primordial age, dwelling in silt-choked deltas and shadowed bayous where the boundary between land and water dissolves. To the uninitiated, it appears as naught but a moss-slicked log, yet beneath that armored hide lies a cold, calculating patience. 

Its hunt is a masterclass in stillness. A crocodile may remain submerged for hours, only its lidless eyes breaking the surface, before erupting with a violence that shatters the river’s peace. Once its serrated jaws lock, it performs the "Spiral of the Deep," a rhythmic, drowning dance that drags the heaviest prey into the crushing dark.

In local lore, the beast is whispered of as the "Keeper of the Silt." The river-folk believe these creatures are the reincarnated spirits of ancient, vengeful sentinels. To see one’s reflection in a crocodile’s golden eye is said to forfeit a portion of the soul to the mud. Travelers are warned: when the reeds go silent and the water turns to glass, do not linger to investigate the ripples. The river has teeth, and they are eternally hungry.
